_comment: GAME_PLAN 29: canned briefs. {name} slots are filled by src/game/narrative.ts; a leading @role sets the SPECTRUM colour of a line (threat, craft, fragment, nuclear, sail, danger, program, planet, text). No LLM at play time: every sentence here was written by a person.

TYPE_CLAUSE.RUBBLE: A RUBBLE PILE: GRAVEL HELD TOGETHER BY ITS OWN WEAK GRAVITY
TYPE_CLAUSE.STONY: A STONY BODY: SOLID ROCK, FRACTURED
TYPE_CLAUSE.IRON: AN IRON BODY: DENSE, STRONG, HARD TO BREAK
TYPE_CLAUSE.ICY: AN ICY BODY: A COMET OF DUST AND ICE

lines: @text LEAD {lead}. CLOSING AT {vinf} KM/S: {energy} MT, {category} CLASS IF IT HITS.
@text LEAD {lead}. CLOSING AT {vinf} KM/S: {energy} MT, {category} CLASS IF IT HITS.

HINT.DEFAULT: PRESS P TO PLAN. EARLY BEATS BIG: A SMALL PUSH NOW IS A LARGE MISS LATER.
HINT.SHORT_LEAD: TOO LATE FOR A SLOW PUSH. KINETIC NOW, OR EVACUATE.
HINT.GLOBAL: A CIVILIZATION-SCALE BODY. EVERYTHING YOU HAVE, AS EARLY AS YOU CAN.
HINT.FRAGILE: WEAK BODY: A HARD HIT MAY BREAK IT. WATCH Q/Q* IN THE PLANNER.

LESSON.SUNWARD: FOUND {lead} BEFORE IMPACT. A SUNWARD SENTINEL WOULD HAVE SEEN IT WEEKS EARLIER (<G> PROGRAMS).
LESSON.LEAD: LEAD {lead}. MORE LEAD BUYS SLOWER, SAFER METHODS: FUND THE SURVEYS.
